desc: Reduce the problem to deleting only negative values, use original Kadane as baseline, and handle best <= 0 by returning it.
Implement the complete O(n log n) solution in the starter code (prefix/suffix gaps, segment tree for middle gaps).
Verify the implemented code on the two provided examples and with a brute-force random tester (small n, small value range).
Confirm time/memory are acceptable for n=1e5 by O(n log n) time and O(n) memory analysis.
